about: Level language for the Oddboro agent office, second room: the Cloister, where a worker that has risen from the Mote Well walks its round before it takes a task. Same scale as the Mote Well (his answer A on odb-mote-well-look-3, 2026-11-23: rooms 30% over the office's 10x9 minimum, so a 13x12 inside). The west exit goes back to the Mote Well; the east exit, the Staff Hall, is a named exit until it is drawn. The round is the covered walk about the garden; one daemon walks it. Seat count and the plate wording are working positions, his to change.
title: Oddboro Office: the Cloister Round

paths.about: Paved walks [x, y, w, h]. The hall runs from the Mote Well exit in the west to the Staff Hall exit in the east; the step joins it to the Cloister door.

walk.about: The moving look: a visitor walks in from the Mote Well end and up to the door; one daemon walks the round once, along the middle of the covered walk.
